title: Concept: Test coverage report published with the app
description: A coverage report page listing source files and their execution counts in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The report names every source path and marks the lines no test executes, which points an attacker at the least observed parts of the code base.
applicability: Deployments that render a coverage report page listing source files and their execution counts into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The report names every source path and marks the lines no test executes, which points an attacker at the least observed parts of the code base.
